contexts.text: When he approached to come into Egypt = when He began to learn.
Such unclean things exhale from them to the sense when they approach the sphere of good Spirits. AC 7225:end. AC 7997.
As the morning went up = when the Kingdom of God approaches.
Abimelech had not approached her... To approach (Sarah as a sister) = to touch, or to consult rational truth in any way. AC 2531.
To see God = approach to Him through interior things... hence presence.
(Jacob) even approached himself even to his brother = conjunction on the part of good by the truth which is Jacob... To approach himself = to conjoin himself.
If he betakes himself to evils, the two Spirits from Hell approach... but if... to good, the two Angels from Heaven approach...
There approached the days of Israel to die = the state just before regeneration... To approach = to be near; thus just before.
Approach thou not hither = that he should not think about the Divine from sensual things... To approach Jehovah = to think about the Divine. Explained.
The approach of Heaven, Signified.
All approach in the Spiritual World is effected by means of determination of thought.
When (the Lord arranges the Heavens in order) Heaven approaches; that is, flows in more strongly.
When (a Spirit or Angel) approaches, it is at once known from this sphere in what faith and in what charity he is...
Pharaoh approached = influx...
Did not come near = no communication.

Come ye near before Jehovah = a state of reception and application... In so far as a man receives the Divine influx, he is said to come near before Him; approach before Jehovah, in the spiritual sense, is nothing else, for approach to Him is effected through faith and love; and since both faith and love are from Jehovah... approach to Him is also the reception of the good and truth inflowing from Him.
If (the inhabitants of our Earth) approach, (those of Jupiter) either flee from them, or repel them.
Moses alone shall come near Jehovah = the conjunction and presence of the Lord through the Word in general.

That to approach is conjunction and presence, is because in the other life the distances of one from another are entirely according to dissimilitudes and diversities of interior things. Explained, Illustrated. AC 9579.
And they shall not come nigh = no separate conjunction and presence.
To approach = conjunction and presence. AC 9997. AC 10001. AC 10021.
Approaches are similitudes as to the state of the interiors...
According to their approach and removal...
If such only approach towards any heavenly Society, the delight of those who are in the Society is diminished...

The delight in which they are when they approach a heavenly Society is the delight of their concupiscences... into which they come from the... removal of the heavenly delight from those who are in it. It is otherwise when there is no such removal; they cannot then approach, because in so far as they then approach, they come into anguish...
Conjunction by approach can be increased to eternity...
When the Judgment was at hand, the Lord caused the Heavens to approach over the World of Spirits... AR 343.
Under Approach, see this reference.
Jehovah God, as He is in His infinite essence, cannot approach Hell...
To come near = to be conjoined by love.
He hath delivered my soul in peace, lest they should come near me () = ... the removal of evils and falsities.
Blessed is he whom thou choosest, and causest to approach () = spiritual affection or love; for so far as he is in this love he is with the Lord; for everyone approaches according to this love.
